==Description==
The '''DJ Booth Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It is made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the Default Level 4 [[DJ Booth]]. Anybody who bought the toy would be emailed a code 24 hours later, which allowed them to get the [[DJ Booth/Gallery#Plushie|{{Color|Other|Plushie}} DJ Booth]] skin. This is no longer the case after the 18th of May 2025.

It is made out of plush fabric and Polypropylene cotton. It is 11.8 inches (29.972 cm) tall, 7.8 inches (19.812 cm) wide and 7.5 inches (19.05 cm) deep. A tree is planted for every order of the '''DJ Booth Plush'''.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:Keep the party going this holiday season with '''DJ Booth Plush'''!

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''DJ Booth Plush''' can be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $34.99. It can also be purchased in a bundle with the pin based on the same tower, which normally cost together $47.98, but are discounted for 10% making the cost $43.18. It is currently unavailable.

Before April 2025, this could be purchased for $29.99, while the bundle could be purchased for $35.98. During the Black Friday 2024 Sale, it could be bought for $22.49, while the bundle had a cost of $23.83. Before April 2023, this could be purchased for $27.99.
